benchmark_title: Motion graphics and transitions on existing footage

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 9.0.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

prompt.text:
Edit the six attached NASA Artemis I clips in `footage/` into a 30-second vertical mission-recap video (1080×1920, 30 fps), with motion graphics and transitions on top.

Use `script.md` for the clip order, exact on-screen text and the facts, which are sourced in `sources/`. The footage is landscape and mixed resolution and frame rate, so reframe each shot for vertical and keep the subject in frame. Add a title, lower thirds, an animated distance counter and an end card. Use at least three different transition types, timed to the music. Keep the real launch sound from clips 02 and 03 under the music bed, and use only the music and sound effects in `benchmarks/shared/audio/`. No voiceover. Aim for a cinematic, high-energy recap.

revision_prompt.text: Revise only the Moon scene (script scene 5). Make the distance counter count up over 2 seconds instead of its current speed, move it to the top third of the frame, and add a thin line under it that draws from left to right. Leave the other scenes, the cut points, the total length and the audio unchanged.

assumptions: Ignition flash taken as the booster ignition flare at clip 02 source time about 4.67 s (30 fps frame 140), placed at timeline frame 108; the steam brightening about 0.3 s earlier was not used.

The director plan cannot put a counter over video. Script scene 5 was split into a 3 s counter graphic (dark gradient, 'miles from Earth' caption) and a 3 s Moon-footage scene carrying the two exact script lines.
The engine counter has no digit grouping, so it counts 0 to 268 with a fixed ',563' suffix so that it lands exactly on '268,563'.
Scene 4 'callout pointing at Earth' was rendered as the lower-third caption only; the build has no arrow or leader-line primitive.

Reframing and the 30 fps conform were done during asset prep (ffmpeg crop/scale at native pixel aspect, fps filter) before import-video, because the engine's asset layout only center-crops ('cover') and covers the bottom 38% with an opaque lower-third panel.

Music bed trimmed to start 6.0 s in, so the drum entry lands on the ignition; natural sound from clips 02/03/06 added as scene-length cues with baked 40/120 ms edge fades; pop/tick SFX padded with silence to whole frames.

Revision: the 2 s count needed a new versioned plan (v3, full produce) because no typed operation edits counter timing; revise-production (v4) then moved the counter and its caption to the top third. The thin line was not delivered (no primitive).

agent_checks.item: All six clips are used in script order, and no frames are stretched or squashed
agent_checks.evidence: Spec timeline: clip01 frames 0-89, clip02 90-215, clip03 216-323, clip04 324-467, counter graphic 468-557, clip05 558-647, clip06 648-791, end card (blurred clip06 freeze) 792-899. Crops keep native pixel aspect: 980x1080, 760x838, 590x650 and 653x720 source regions scaled to 1080x1190 (ratio error 0.02-0.08%), SAR 1.

agent_checks.item: Every shot is reframed for vertical with its main subject in frame (the rocket, Earth's crescent, the Moon and the parachutes)
agent_checks.evidence: Draft frames 0/60/89 show the rocket and tower; 100-215 the booster base and flash; 224-318 the rocket rising between the pad towers; 330-467 Earth's crescent (top edge slightly cropped by the 1.15 zoom near frame 467 but crescent readable); 560-647 the Moon fully in frame; 650-760 both parachute clusters and the capsule splash. Footage occupies the top 62% of the frame above the engine's fixed lower-third panel.

agent_checks.item: The "913" burn-in in clip 02 is never visible, and neither are clip 04's pillarbox bars
agent_checks.evidence: Clip 02 crop is source x 0-979; the 913 burn-in sits at about x 1470-1640. Clip 04 active picture measured at x 160-1119; the crop is x 470-1059. Frames 90-215 and 324-467 inspected: no 913 and no black side bars.

agent_checks.item: Motion is smooth after conforming to 30 fps: no stutter, repeated frames or interlace artifacts
agent_checks.evidence: Clips conformed with the ffmpeg fps=30 filter (nearest-frame, no blending) from 59.94/60 fps. MD5 of all 900 rendered PNG frames: no identical consecutive frames inside any footage scene; repeats only in the counter hold (510-557) and the still end card hold (821-884), both intended. No combing seen in inspected frames.

agent_checks.item: The ignition flash in clip 02 lands with the impact SFX (within ±2 frames)
agent_checks.evidence: Impact cue sfx_2_2 starts at frame 108. Mean luma of the output jumps 58 -> 64 -> 68 at frames 107-109, the largest step in scene 2 (booster ignition flare, source frame 140 of the 30 fps conform). The music bed was trimmed to start 6.0 s in so the drum entry also lands at frame 108. Offset 0 frames. Note: a smaller steam brightening at 98-99 could also be read as the flash.

agent_checks.item: Every line in script.md appears exactly and is readable against the footage (contrast, safe area)
agent_checks.evidence: Spec onScreen text matches all script lines byte for byte, including the middle dots: ARTEMIS I / NASA's uncrewed test flight around the Moon / Liftoff / Nov. 16, 2022 · 1:47 a.m. EST / Launch Pad 39B / Kennedy Space Center, Florida / Orion looks back at Earth / 268,563 miles from Earth (frames 558-647) / 43,471 miles beyond the far side of the Moon / Splashdown / Dec. 11, 2022 · off the coast of San Diego / 25 days, 10 hours, 53 minutes / Footage: NASA. White text on the #06080D panel (about 19:1 contrast), inside the 76 px safe inset. The added counter caption 'miles from Earth' is not a script line. Caveat: subtitles are 41 px (the engine's fixed size), small on a phone.

agent_checks.item: At least three distinct transition types are used, cut on the beat or on action
agent_checks.evidence: Hard cuts at 90 (on the ignition action, with the impact) and 648. Whip-pan entrances at 216 (whip_right) and 558 (whip_left) with a whoosh. Dips through dark at 324 (12 f), 468 (10 f) and 792 (16 f). All cuts are multiples of 18 frames (one beat at 100 BPM), and the music is offset by 180 frames, which keeps the grid aligned.

Draft frames 513-557 show '268,563' (revision: frames 527-557). Caveat: the engine counter has no thousands grouping (v1 showed '268563'), so the counter counts 0 to 268 with a fixed ',563' suffix. The last three digits do not roll.

agent_checks.item: Launch natural sound is audible under the music, and the silent clips have no dropouts or clicks. True peak ≤ −1 dBTP.
agent_checks.evidence: The nat02 and nat03 excerpts at -3 dB measure -26/-25 dBFS RMS against the -22 dBFS music bed. Section RMS is -20.5/-20.0 dBFS in scenes 2-3 versus -21.6 in the music-only scene 4. The music is continuous across the silent clips 01/04/05. The largest sample step within ±200 samples of each cut is 511-725, against a 99.9th-percentile step of 2734, so there are no clicks. ebur128 true peak is -2.8 dBTP; integrated loudness is -22.6 LUFS. The mix is mono.

agent_checks.item: Revision: only scene 5 changed. The cut points and other scenes are identical to the draft.
agent_checks.evidence: Scene-module PNG tree hashes and audio mix hashes are identical for all scenes except scene_5 (frames 468-557). Cut points are unchanged. Decoded MP4 frames outside 468-557 differ only from H.264 re-encoding: PSNR ≥61 dB for 441-467 and 558-561, identical elsewhere. The audio stream is identical.

agent_checks.item: Revision request fully applied (2 s count, top third, thin line drawing left to right)
agent_checks.evidence: Count-up is now 60 frames (468-528), and the counter sits at y 180-540 (top third) with its caption at y 500-620. The thin line under the counter was NOT added: the build has no line/stroke primitive and no typed revision operation that adds an element. The 2 s timing needed a new versioned plan (v3, full re-render) before the scoped revise-production step (v4).

notes: Draft = v2 (v1 rendered the counter as '268563' without a comma and was rejected after inspection). The PATH motion-engine reports 0.63.1 (a stray global install); all production used the checkout venv at 0.68.0. Output audio is mono. Integrated loudness is -22.6 LUFS, true peak -2.8 dBTP. Engine layout: footage in the top 62%, text on an opaque panel below; title and subtitle sizes are fixed by the compiler (59/41 px).

owner_review.comment: The worst of the three: bad overall, with really bad sound design.
